what: While the logo mark pinned at the center of the Hero is being drawn (default 2.1s, or until the mark emits fx:mark-done), it waits, rests .5s, then flies to the top-edge center of the head slot, shrinking to fit the slot width (.5 if 200px → 100px) over .7s cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1) — a curve that is slow at the start and end and sharply fast in the middle. Once it lands, the mark hides and the same logo inside the slot (ring animation and so on) turns on and fires fx:docked. After that, the body cells appear .05s apart, each over .4s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1)

options.wait: Max time in seconds to wait while the mark is drawn, default 2.1 — once the mark fires fx:mark-done, it proceeds from then
options.pause · dur: Rest after drawing · fly-away duration (seconds), default .5 · .7 — shorten for screens opened often
options.reveal · stagger: Body text reveal duration · delay between cells (sec), default .4 · .05
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Mark drawn from the center (child, required) — for Lottie, emit fx:mark-done on complete and it stays in sync
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Head slot where the marker sits (child, required) — children inside become visible after it sits (is-docked)
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Body slot that appears after sitting (children, multiple)
options.fx:docked: Event fired when the element sits

note: The original uses framer-motion animate(top · scale, .7s [.87,0,.13,1]) to drive the curtain Lottie (2.1s), blocks scroll during the intro, and clears the marker 1s after it settles. This part does not block scroll (the host page does it with body overflow)

from.where: index.html .tb-intro → .tb-home__slot — original curtain intro (Lottie 63 frames at 29.97fps · .5s pause · .7s [.87,0,.13,1] · scale .5 · body .4s [.77,0,.175,1])
